require 'openssl'
require 'sinatra'
require 'fileutils'
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'

module CryptoVault
  UPLOAD_DIR = '/var/cryptovault/uploads'
  CERT_DIR = '/var/cryptovault/certs'
  ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.pem .crt .key .p12 .pfx].freeze
  MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024 # 10MB

  # Admin token used to authenticate privileged operations such as shutdown.
  # Must be provided via the environment; endpoint is disabled if unset.
  ADMIN_TOKEN = ENV['CRYPTOVAULT_ADMIN_TOKEN']

  class ShutdownHandler
    def initialize
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @pending_operations = []
      @shutting_down = false
    end

    def register_operation(op_id, metadata)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        return false if @shutting_down
        @pending_operations << { id: op_id, meta: metadata, started_at: Time.now }
        true
      end
    end

    def complete_operation(op_id)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @pending_operations.reject! { |op| op[:id] == op_id }
      end
    end

    def initiate_shutdown
      @mutex.synchronize { @shutting_down = true }
      # Wait for pending operations to complete
      sleep(0.1) until @mutex.synchronize { @pending_operations.empty? }
    end

    def shutting_down?
      @mutex.synchronize { @shutting_down }
    end
  end

  class CertificateProcessor
    def initialize(shutdown_handler)
      @shutdown_handler = shutdown_handler
    end

    def validate_certificate_format(content)
      begin
        OpenSSL::X509::Certificate.new(content)
        return :x509
      rescue OpenSSL::X509::CertificateError
        # Not an X509 cert, try other formats
      end

      begin
        OpenSSL::PKey.read(content)
        return :private_key
      rescue OpenSSL::PKey::PKeyError
        # Not a private key
      end

      begin
        OpenSSL::PKCS12.new(content)
        return :pkcs12
      rescue StandardError
        # Not PKCS12
      end

      :unknown
    end

    def compute_fingerprint(content)
      OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(content)
    end

    def derive_storage_path(original_filename, fingerprint)
      ext = File.extname(original_filename).downcase
      sanitized_base = File.basename(original_filename, ext)
        .gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, '_')
        .slice(0, 64)
      "#{sanitized_base}_#{fingerprint[0..7]}#{ext}"
    end
  end

  class UploadValidator
    MAGIC_BYTES = {
      '.p12' => nil,
      '.pfx' => nil,
      '.pem' => '-----BEGIN',
      '.crt' => '-----BEGIN',
      '.key' => '-----BEGIN'
    }.freeze

    def validate_upload(filename, content, content_type)
      errors = []
      ext = File.extname(filename).downcase

      unless ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(ext)
        errors << "Extension '#{ext}' not allowed"
      end

      if content.bytesize > MAX_FILE_SIZE
        errors << "File exceeds maximum size of #{MAX_FILE_SIZE} bytes"
      end

      if content.bytesize == 0
        errors << "Empty file not allowed"
      end

      # Validate magic bytes for text-based formats
      if MAGIC_BYTES[ext] && !content.start_with?(MAGIC_BYTES[ext])
        errors << "File content does not match expected format for #{ext}"
      end

      errors
    end

    def safe_filename?(filename)
      # Check for path traversal
      normalized = File.expand_path(filename, '/')
      File.dirname(normalized) == '/'
    end
  end

  class Application < Sinatra::Base
    configure do
      set :shutdown_handler, ShutdownHandler.new
      set :cert_processor, CertificateProcessor.new(settings.shutdown_handler)
      set :upload_validator, UploadValidator.new
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(UPLOAD_DIR)
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(CERT_DIR)
    end

    helpers do
      def authorized_admin?
        provided = request.env['HTTP_X_ADMIN_TOKEN'].to_s
        return false if ADMIN_TOKEN.nil? || ADMIN_TOKEN.empty?
        return false if provided.empty?
        # Constant-time comparison to avoid timing attacks
        Rack::Utils.secure_compare(ADMIN_TOKEN, provided)
      end
    end

    before do
      if settings.shutdown_handler.shutting_down?
        halt 503, { error: 'Service shutting down' }.to_json
      end
    end

    post '/api/v1/certificates/upload' do
      content_type :json
      
      unless params[:file] && params[:file][:tempfile]
        halt 400, { error: 'No file provided' }.to_json
      end

      file = params[:file]
      filename = file[:filename]
      content = file[:tempfile].read
      file_content_type = file[:type]

      op_id = SecureRandom.uuid
      unless settings.shutdown_handler.register_operation(op_id, { filename: filename })
        halt 503, { error: 'Service shutting down' }.to_json
      end

      begin
        # Phase 1: Validate the upload
        validator = settings.upload_validator
        errors = validator.validate_upload(filename, content, file_content_type)
        
        unless validator.safe_filename?(filename)
          errors << "Invalid filename"
        end

        unless errors.empty?
          halt 422, { errors: errors }.to_json
        end

        # Phase 2: Process the certificate
        processor = settings.cert_processor
        cert_type = processor.validate_certificate_format(content)
        fingerprint = processor.compute_fingerprint(content)
        storage_name = processor.derive_storage_path(filename, fingerprint)

        # Phase 3: Store the file - only store valid certificate formats
        if cert_type == :unknown
          halt 422, { error: 'File is not a recognized certificate format' }.to_json
        end

        target_dir = CERT_DIR
        target_path = File.join(target_dir, storage_name)

        # Final path safety check - verify resolved path is within CERT_DIR
        # Use dirname of target_path to check before writing
        resolved_dir = File.realpath(File.dirname(target_path))
        unless resolved_dir.start_with?(File.realpath(CERT_DIR))
          halt 500, { error: 'Storage path violation' }.to_json
        end

        File.write(target_path, content)

        {
          status: 'success',
          fingerprint: fingerprint,
          cert_type: cert_type.to_s,
          stored_as: storage_name
        }.to_json

      ensure
        settings.shutdown_handler.complete_operation(op_id)
      end
    end

    post '/api/v1/admin/shutdown' do
      content_type :json
      unless authorized_admin?
        halt 401, { error: 'Unauthorized' }.to_json
      end
      Thread.new { settings.shutdown_handler.initiate_shutdown }
      { status: 'shutdown_initiated' }.to_json
    end
  end
end
